jobs.title: Director, People Operations
jobs.description:
About the Job:

LaunchDarkly is looking for a Director, People Operations to lead the operating model, service delivery, and continuous improvement of People Operations and Talent Acquisition operations across the employee and candidate lifecycles.

Reporting to the Senior Director, People Operations, you will lead a connected portfolio spanning global People Operations, Talent Acquisition Operations, employee and candidate experience, compliance-related workflows, operational governance, and team capability. You will translate business and People priorities into clear ownership, scalable processes, strong controls, and a reliable operating rhythm.

This role will work in close partnership with the Director, People Programs, Systems & Analytics. The Director, People Operations will own operational outcomes, service delivery, process execution, and stakeholder partnership. The Director, People Programs, Systems & Analytics will own the strategy and roadmap for People programs, systems, analytics, AI, data governance, and change enablement. Together, these leaders will create a practical, integrated People operating model that is trusted by employees, candidates, managers, HRBPs, and business leaders.

Responsibilities:

People Operations leadership

- Establish the global People Operations operating model across the employee lifecycle, including onboarding, offboarding, employee data changes, employment documentation, employee support, contingent workforce processes, international operations, and related service delivery.

- Manage the activities of the People Operations and Talent Acquisition Operations teams, creating clear expectations, effective prioritization, strong collaboration, and a culture of ownership and continuous improvement.

- Establish service standards, escalation paths, operating rhythms, and ownership models that make it easy for employees, managers, HRBPs, and cross-functional partners to get the right support.

- Own operational readiness and execution for policies, compliance-related workflows, employment agreements, audits, immigration and mobility processes, accommodations, background checks, and other high-risk employee lifecycle activities in partnership with Legal and relevant subject-matter experts.

- Improve the consistency, quality, and equity of the employee experience across U.S. and international processes while accounting for local requirements and operational complexity.

- Build scalable documentation, self-service resources, controls, and standard operating procedures that reduce avoidable manual work and improve accuracy.

- Manage key People Operations vendors and partnerships, including service quality, contracts, issue resolution, risk management, and performance against expectations.

- Serve as an escalation point for complex People Operations issues, using sound judgment, discretion, and a strong understanding of employee trust and business risk.

Talent Acquisition Operations

- Establish  the operating model for Talent Acquisition Operations, including recruiting intake, role setup, approvals, job posting workflows, interview coordination, interview loop management, candidate communications, offer process support, and recruiting operations reporting.

- Partner with Talent Acquisition leadership to improve recruiter and coordinator capacity, operating discipline, candidate experience, hiring-manager partnership, and consistency across recruiting workflows.

- Establish clear ownership and service standards across recruiting operations, including intake quality, scheduling, interview readiness, candidate handoffs, and offer-to-onboarding transitions.

- Identify opportunities to simplify and strengthen Greenhouse and connected recruiting workflows in partnership with the Director, People Programs, Systems & Analytics and technical partners.

- Support scalable recruiting programs, vendor management, executive recruiting operations, contingent recruiting processes, and other Talent Acquisition priorities as the business evolves.

- Use recruiting and operational signals to surface bottlenecks, clarify tradeoffs, and recommend improvements to hiring velocity, quality, candidate experience, and team capacity.

Partnership with People Programs, Systems & Analytics

- Partner with the Director, People Programs, Systems & Analytics to maintain one integrated roadmap across People Operations, Talent Acquisition Operations, People programs, systems, analytics, and AI.

- Translate operational pain points and stakeholder needs into clear requirements, process improvements, system enhancements, reporting needs, and measurable outcomes.

- Jointly define operating metrics, service-level expectations, data requirements, and success measures for employee and candidate lifecycle processes.

- Ensure new systems, workflows, programs, and automation are operationally sound, documented, adopted, and supported after launch.

- Partner on data quality, process governance, access controls, reporting definitions, and responsible use of automation and AI involving employee or candidate information.

- Create a disciplined operating rhythm for prioritization, dependency management, risk review, decision-making, and communication across the People portfolio.

Cross-functional partnership and change

- Partner closely with HRBPs, Recruiting, Finance, Legal, IT, AppEng, TechOps, Payroll, Workplace, Internal Communications, and external vendors to deliver reliable People and Talent processes.

- Lead change adoption for operational changes, including stakeholder alignment, communications, training, readiness, issue management, and post-launch improvement.

- Bring structure to ambiguous work, identify root causes, and make practical decisions that balance employee experience, candidate experience, compliance, speed, scalability, and cost.

- Represent People Operations and Talent Acquisition Operations in cross-functional planning, business reviews, and executive discussions.

- Build strong relationships with business leaders and managers so People processes are understood, usable, and aligned to business needs.

Qualifications:

- You are a thoughtful, service-oriented People leader who combines operational discipline with empathy and care.

- You create clarity in complex environments and are comfortable making decisions when ownership, process, or information is incomplete.

- You see the connections between People Operations, Talent Acquisition, systems, data, compliance, and employee experience.

- You are hands-on enough to understand how work gets done and strategic enough to build a model that scales.

- You build trust through sound judgment, transparency, follow-through, and respect for confidential information.

- You are collaborative and pragmatic, with a strong instinct for root-cause analysis and continuous improvement.

- You care about creating consistent, equitable, and people-centered experiences for employees, candidates, managers, and internal partners.

What Success Looks Like

- People Operations and Talent Acquisition Operations have clear ownership, service standards, escalation paths, and operating rhythms.

- Employees, candidates, managers, HRBPs, and business leaders experience more consistent, responsive, and equitable support.

- Core employee and candidate lifecycle processes are documented, measurable, scalable, and supported by appropriate controls and self-service resources.

- People Operations and Talent Acquisition Operations teams are engaged, capable, and organized around the highest-value work.

- Greenhouse and connected workflows support a reliable, efficient, and high-quality recruiting experience in partnership with the People systems function.

- The People team has a clear, integrated roadmap across operational execution, programs, systems, analytics, and AI, with well-managed dependencies and decisions.

- Operational risks, data-quality issues, manual work, and process fragmentation are identified early and reduced over time.

- People leaders and business partners trust the function to deliver practical solutions, communicate clearly, and follow through on commitments.

Pay:

Target pay ranges based on Geographic Zones* for Level M4:

- Zone 1: San Francisco/Bay Area or NYC Metropolitan Area, Boston, Seattle - $191,800 - $263,670**

- Zone 2: Irvine, LA, Monterey, Santa Barbara, Santa Rosa, Austin, Portland, Philadelphia, Chicago - $172,600 - $237,270*

- Zone 3: All other US locations - $163,000 - $224,070**

- All Zones Inclusive of a 15% Bonus Target

LaunchDarkly operates from a place of high trust and transparency; we are happy to state the pay range for our open roles to best align with your needs. Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, and location.

*Within the United States, our geographic pay zones are defined by counties surrounding major metropolitan areas.
**Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), health, vision, and dental insurance, and mental health benefits in addition to salary.

About LaunchDarkly:

Modern software delivery was supposed to be the foundation for a thriving digital business but reality has proven otherwise. Slow, inefficient development cycles, costly outages, and fragmented customer experiences are preventing developers from building their best software. The LaunchDarkly platform helps developers innovate on new features faster while protecting them with a safety valve to instantly rewind when things go wrong. Developers can target product experiences to any customer segment and maximize the business impact of every feature. And by gradually rolling out new application components, they escape nightmare "big-bang" technology migrations.

The LaunchDarkly platform was built to guide engineers to the next frontier of DevOps by:

- Improving the velocity and stability of software releases, without the fear of end customer outages

- Delivering targeted experiences by easily personalizing features to customer cohorts

- Maximizing the business impact of every feature through the ability to experiment and optimize

- Coordinating the release and optimization of software to provide consistent experiences across mobile platforms and device types

- Improving the effectiveness and productivity of engineering teams, by providing insights into engineering cadence and stability

At LaunchDarkly, we believe in the power of teams. We're building a team that is humble, open, collaborative, respectful and kind. jobs.description:
About the Job:

The Manager of Digital Customer Success will report to the Director of Customer Success, Americas, and lead a team of Digital CSMs who serve as the primary post-sale point of contact for LaunchDarkly’s largest subset of customers. The ideal candidate is a people-first leader who is passionate about delivering an exceptional customer experience, brings an innovative approach to Customer Success, and thrives in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. This role is a unique opportunity to shape and lead a team in a growing market at LaunchDarkly, driving both customer success and organizational growth.

Responsibilities:

- Team Leadership and Development: Recruit, lead, and develop a high-performing team of CSMs. Provide ongoing coaching, support, and feedback to help the team grow their skills, deliver strong customer outcomes, and consistently meet or exceed expectations.

- Scaled Strategy and Execution: Partner closely with the GTM ecosystem and other CS teams to build and operationalize Customer Success programs and playbooks tailored to the Digital customer segment, ensuring alignment with our global CS frameworks.

- Proactive Customer Insight: Enable the team to understand and act early on leading indicators such as onboarding progress, product adoption, risk signals, and expansion potential, in order to reduce churn and drive growth.

- Operational Execution: Bring operational rigor to the team by organizing around key performance metrics, including NDR and expansion, and running regular forecast and pipeline reviews to ensure we deliver against both short- and long-term goals.

- Customer Engagement: Serve as the senior advocate for strategic and high-impact customers. Oversee critical engagements and escalations, and ensure customer needs and insights inform internal decisions. LaunchDarkly is a startup environment, and everyone stays close to customers.

About You:

- Leadership: Demonstrated ability to lead and develop high-performing teams.

- Entrepreneurial Spirit: Driven, proactive, and comfortable operating in a highly ambiguous, startup environment.

- Passion for Growth (your own, and your teams): Enthusiastic about continuous learning and personal development. Actively seeks and provides feedback. You consider promoting a team member the best deal you could possibly close!

- Analytical: Enjoys identifying trends in data and making informed decisions about team and customer outcomes.

- Program Builder: Passionate about building high-impact, customer focused programs. Able to build and execute a project plan, holding stakeholders accountable to a timeline.

- Sales oriented: You have experience owning a number and want to continue to do so. Customer Success at LaunchDarkly is a commercial function, you should be excited about having commercial responsibility.

- Problem Solver: Strong critical thinking skills and enjoys solving complex customer problems.

- Team Player: Collaborates well with others, knows when to involve other stakeholders, and proactively keeps others informed.

Qualifications:

- Experience: Minimum of 4 years in a customer-facing role, with at least 2 years in a leadership or team lead position within customer success, account management, or a similar field.

- Commercial Acumen: Experience owning the renewal process and being accountable for a retention quota. Strong discovery, qualification, and sales skills; training in Command of the Message, MEDDIC, or similar methodologies is preferred.

- Data Orientation: Experience leveraging data to make decisions about talent, team effectiveness, customer programs, etc.

- Program Development: Background in building scalable programs to positively impact broad cohorts of customers, leveraging signals and fine-tuned collateral

- AI Fluency: Comfortable leveraging AI to scale the impact of proven processes and tools, while ensuring our customers are provided accurate and actionable insights

- Technical Knowledge: Experience working with technical products, preferably within the DevOps space, and interacting with developers or technical personas.

- Project Management: Strong project management skills, with experience holding customers and cross-functional teams accountable to timelines.

jobs.description:
About the Job:

As a Regional Sales Director, you’ll own Enterprise sales performance and strategy within the East region of the US and Canada. You’ll lead a high-performing team of experienced Enterprise Account Executives focused on new business and expansion opportunities. You’ll collaborate cross-functionally to drive regional performance and support complex enterprise sales engagements.

This role is ideal for a sales leader who understands the developer tools space, is passionate about solving complex problems, and can thrive in a high-growth SaaS environment. This role will report to our VP Americas and will have a Central & West team counterpart.

Responsibilities:

- Oversee a high-performing East sales team focused on new business and expansion opportunities.

- Lead, develop, and manage a group of Enterprise Account Executives, calling on businesses with more than 1,000 employees (including Fortune 500 accounts, $1M Install Base).

- Provide executive leadership, including sales forecasting, territory assignments, sales coaching, and commission planning.

- Assist with selling activities as appropriate and ensure the sales team is working collaboratively with Operations, Sales Engineering, and other internal and external teams.

- Work with senior leadership on the development of annual sales forecasts.

- Own quarterly and annual team quotas.

- Lead recruitment and retention activities.

Qualifications:

- 10+ years of enterprise SaaS software sales experience, including 5+ years in enterprise sales management.

- Proven track record of meeting and exceeding quota and leading an experienced sales team across the sales cycle.

- Ability to build and lead a sales organization, including quota-carrying and forecasting experience.

- Familiarity working within a MEDDPICC and Command of the Message environment (or similar)

jobs.title: Senior Customer Success Manager - EMEA
jobs.description:
About the Job:

The Customer Success Manager reports directly into the regional CS leader and represents LaunchDarkly as the direct point-of-contact with our customers post-sales. They are LaunchDarkly subject-matter experts guiding our new and expanding customers towards implementation and adoption and helping them achieve their desired use-cases and realize value. The best candidate for this role will be passionate about customer success with a keen interest in software development and DevOps, balanced with a strong sales acumen. In LaunchDarkly GTM, we are all customer-obsessed and striving for massive year over year growth.

Responsibilities:

- Customer Onboarding: You will shepherd in new customers from the sales handoff through successful activation in the product. This includes building out success plans to get customers up to speed in the platform, project management through onboarding, helping customers leverage the most appropriate enablement paths and assessing customer’s adoption on an ongoing basis.

- Risk Identification and Mitigation: You’ll work to proactively identify and diagnose risk inhibiting adoption or that may cause churn and contraction. You’ll own building a risk mitigation strategy and coordinating across the account team to effectively steer the customer to success.

- Technical Guidance: You’ll maintain a deep level of LaunchDarkly product knowledge and be expected to provide customers with direction on implementation and adoption best practices.

- Prescriptively Sell: You maintain a pulse on how our customers are tracking against their key goals and outcomes identifying opportunities for customers to purchase additional products, services and adopt new features needed for them to maximize the value of our solution.

- Trusted Advisor: You understand your customers like no other and have built enough trust to act as an extension of their team. You provide prescriptive guidance to customers to help them get the most out of their LaunchDarkly purchase.

- Build Champions & Executive Relationships: You are an expert champion builder. You consistently work to identify & support key advocates within your customers’ organization who actively promote the value of LaunchDarkly. In partnership with your Champion, you’re able to leverage success metrics & value driven insights to gain sponsorship at an Executive level.

- Renewal and Expansion focused: You are comfortable owning a number and forecasting on a weekly basis. You will work directly with customers, sales and deal desk to execute renewal agreements on time and to identify expansion opportunities within your accounts

About You:

- Entrepreneurial and Self-Motivated: You are driven and proactive, taking ownership of your role and responsibilities. You operate with a high level of urgency at all times. You thrive in a fast paced, start-up environment.

- Passion for Learning and Growth: You are enthusiastic about continuous learning and personal development at LaunchDarkly. You view feedback as a necessity for growth so consistently seek it out and give it.

- Intellectual Curiosity: You have a hunger for knowledge and are naturally a question-asker.

- Excellent Communication: Your written and spoken communication skills are outstanding.

- Organized & Autonomous: You are capable of efficiently managing your workload and have a process for time management. You do not require a lot of external direction to prioritize your work.

- Highly Adaptable: You excel in a fast-paced and dynamic organizational setting.

- Strong Sales Acumen: You have a high level of sales acumen, strong negotiation skills and are eager to own a number. This is a commercially focused CS organization.

- Natural Problem Solver: You have strong critical thinking skills and enjoy the process of solving complex customer problems. You are able to escalate issues when necessary in a clear, effective manner.

- Team Player: You collaborate well with others, know when to pull specialists or leaders in and keep others informed proactively. Win as a team!

Qualifications:

- 5+ years in a customer-facing role, ideally in account management, customer/partner success or onboarding/implementation with a track record of exceeding targets.

- Experience owning the renewal process and being held accountable to a retention quota. This is a commercially oriented Customer Success team.

- Strong discovery and qualification skills; training in Command of the Message, MEDDIC or another sales methodology is preferred.

- Strong project management skills. You should have experience holding customers and cross-functional teams accountable to a timeline.

- Experience working on a technical product, ideally interacting with developers or other technical personas as your primary customer. Experience within the DevOps space preferred.

- Experience with both proactive and reactive customer success motions.

- We will teach you all about LaunchDarkly, but you should have an existing level of technical knowledge and know-how.

- Proven ability to advocate for both your customers and your company. You know how to be the voice of the customer in the company while mediating between the customer's requests and the company's vision.

jobs.title: Senior Growth Marketing Analyst
jobs.description:
About the Job:

At LaunchDarkly, our Product-Led Growth (PLG) motion is evolving rapidly. We are looking for an experienced, highly analytical, and strategic Senior Growth Marketing Analyst to help us decode the digital body language of our prospects and users.

In this role, you will leverage wide-ranging experience across GTM disciplines to help build, optimize, and scale our PLG engines. Reporting to the Principal Growth Marketer or Director of Growth Marketing, you will resolve complex data and operational issues requiring an in-depth evaluation of variable factors mapping user and account signals across channels, establishing the "next best action" for high-value leads, and optimizing conversion pathways. You will act with a high degree of independence to determine methods and procedures on new assignments, collaborating across Marketing, Product, RevOps, and Data engineering teams to drive function-impacting results.

Responsibilities:

- Data & Signal Strategy

- Audit, track, and categorize 1st-party, 3rd-party (e.g., 6sense, GitHub), and product/marketing signals across target contacts and enterprise accounts.

- Evaluate variable factors and intangible data nuances to distinguish technical practitioner actions (e.g., SDK deployment) from broader enterprise intent (e.g., security evaluations).

- Partner cross-functionally with Data Engineering and RevOps to clean, enrich, and continuously source high-intent signal data.

- Feed signal combinations, recency, and frequency into predictive models to refine lead routing and account prioritization.

- Activation Strategy

- Use signal combinations to define the right "next best action" for accounts and individual users based on their segment, ICP fit, and stage (e.g., prospect vs. existing customer).

- Map and trigger appropriate activation responses ranging from personalized marketing content to white-glove outreach from Product Advocates or automated handoffs to SDRs and Enterprise AEs.

- Operational Motion & Cross-Functional Integration

- Act as the primary business lead to cross-functionally implement, refine, and maintain activation workflows across Marketing, Product, Sales Ops, and Data teams.

- Apply an understanding of the interrelationships between different disciplines to navigate complex cross-team dependencies and drive strategic alignment.

- Help define and iterate on sales-facing tools (such as a "single pane of glass" interface) that surface product affinity, app usage, intent signals, and account fit to enable sales execution.

- Maintain structured feedback loops with Product Advocates, SDRs, and sales reps to assess lead quality and continuously refine signal logic.

- Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) & Experimentation

- Analyze and optimize conversion rates across the end-to-end flow—from initial signal capture to activation, handoff, and pipeline generation.

- Independently design and run growth experiments (in-product onboarding adjustments, messaging, routing logic) to maximize engagement and move accounts through the buyer journey.

- System Administration & Technical Tooling

- Manage technical configuration, tracking setups, and ongoing maintenance for core data and analytics platforms (e.g., GA360/GA4, customer data platforms, product analytics).

- Maintain rigorous data flow standards and proper tag/tracking setups across web properties, marketing tools, and product analytics environments.

Qualifications:

- Experience: Minimum of 8–10 years of related experience in growth marketing, marketing analytics, revenue operations, or PLG strategy within a high-growth B2B SaaS environment.

- Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Data Analytics, Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

- Cross-Disciplinary Expertise: Deep understanding of B2B SaaS growth tactics, PLG motions, marketing technology stacks, and revenue analytics, with a proven ability to bridge Marketing, Sales Ops, Data, and Product management.

- Independent Problem Solving: Proven track record of independently determining methods and procedures on complex, ambiguous assignments requiring evaluation of variable factors.

- Technical: Hands-on proficiency with web analytics (GA360/GA4), product analytics (e.g., Amplitude, Mixpanel), CDPs, SQL, and CRM/automation platforms.

jobs.description:
About the Job:

LaunchDarkly is looking for a Senior Program Manager to help the Revenue Operations team scale efficiently. This role drives cross-functional programs, streamlines processes, and delivers data-driven solutions that accelerate predictable SaaS revenue growth. You'll be the person who turns strategic priorities into structured plans, keeps cross-functional teams aligned, and makes sure risks and blockers get surfaced and resolved before they slow the business down.

The mission of the Senior Program Manager is to enable the Revenue Operations team to scale efficiently by driving cross-functional programs, streamlining processes, and delivering data-driven solutions that accelerate predictable SaaS revenue growth.

Responsibilities:

- Drive Strategic RevOps Initiatives

- Translate strategic priorities into structured program plans

- Define milestones, owners, and deliverables

- Track progress and outcomes against plan

- Manage dependencies and escalate blockers as needed

- Establish Program Governance & Cadences

- Establish operating rhythms for cross-functional programs

- Run status and steering meetings

- Maintain decision and action logs

- Standardize reporting across programs

- Manage Cross-Functional Alignment

- Coordinate across RevOps and Field (Sales, CS, Marketing) teams

- Clarify roles and responsibilities across program stakeholders

- Align teams on priorities and timelines

- Facilitate decisions and communicate updates to stakeholders and leadership

- Manage Risks, Issues & Dependencies

- Identify risks early and maintain risk logs

- Develop mitigation plans

- Resolve cross-functional dependencies

- Escalate decisions requiring leadership input

Qualifications:

- 10+ years of experience in program management, project management, or operations, ideally supporting a Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or GTM function

- Comfortable managing risk logs, mitigation plans, and escalation processes

jobs.title: Strategic Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
About the Job:

The Customer Success Manager reports directly into the regional CS leader and represents LaunchDarkly as the direct point-of-contact with our customers post-sales. They are LaunchDarkly subject-matter experts guiding our new and expanding customers towards implementation and adoption and helping them achieve their desired use-cases and realize value. The best candidate for this role will be passionate about customer success with a keen interest in software development and DevOps, balanced with a strong sales acumen. In LaunchDarkly GTM, we are all customer-obsessed and striving for massive year-over-year growth.

Responsibilities:

- Customer Onboarding: You will shepherd in new customers from the sales handoff through successful activation in the product. This includes building out success plans to get customers up to speed in the platform, project management through onboarding, helping customers leverage the most appropriate enablement paths and assessing customer’s adoption on an ongoing basis.

- Risk Identification and Mitigation: You’ll work to proactively identify and diagnose risk-inhibiting adoption or that may cause churn and contraction. You’ll own building a risk mitigation strategy and coordinating across the account team to effectively steer the customer to success.

- Technical Guidance: You’ll maintain a deep level of LaunchDarkly product knowledge and be expected to provide customers with direction on implementation and adoption best practices.

- Prescriptively Sell: You will maintain a pulse on how our customers are tracking against their key goals and outcomes, identifying opportunities for customers to purchase additional products, services, and adopt new features needed for them to maximize the value of our solution.

- Trusted Advisor: You understand your customers like no other and have built enough trust to act as an extension of their team. You provide prescriptive guidance to customers to help them get the most out of their LaunchDarkly purchase.

- Build Champions & Executive Relationships: You are an expert champion builder. You consistently work to identify & support key advocates within your customers’ organization who actively promote the value of LaunchDarkly. In partnership with your Champion, you’re able to leverage success metrics & value driven insights to gain sponsorship at an Executive level.
Renewal and Expansion focused: You are comfortable owning a number and forecasting on a weekly basis. You will work directly with customers, sales and deal desk to execute renewal agreements on time and to identify expansion opportunities within your accounts

Qualifications:

- 5+ years in a customer facing role, ideally in account management, customer/partner success or onboarding/implementation with a track record of exceeding targets.

- Experience owning the renewal process and being held accountable to a retention quota. This is a commercially oriented Customer Success team.

- Strong discovery and qualification skills; training in Command of the Message, MEDDIC or another sales methodology is preferred.

- Strong project management skills. You should have experience holding customers and cross-functional teams accountable to a timeline.

- Experience working on a technical product ideally interacting with developers or other technical personas as your primary customer. Experience within the DevOps space preferred.

- Experience with both proactive and reactive customer success motions.

- We will teach you all about LaunchDarkly, but you should have an existing level of technical knowledge and know-how.

- Proven ability to advocate for both your customers and your company. You know how to be the voice of the customer in the company while mediating between the customer's requests and the company's vision.
